title: Quintessence (dynamical scalar-field dark energy)
efc_relevance: A canonical scalar φ with V(φ) drives late-time acceleration (w > −1 always). Competing ontology vs EFC: quintessence adds a new degree of freedom, EFC re-derives DE dynamics from entropic flow on existing geometry. Discriminator: quintessence cannot cross w = −1; EFC can if T(a) inverts sign.
ledger_action: Logged as competitor to EFC's L2→L3 mechanism. Compare recovery conditions in WP1.
